subject: Injury claim – parking-lot rear-end incident
body: While exiting a shopping center parking lot my vehicle was struck from behind by another car that failed to stop in time. The collision was at low speed. The airbag did not deploy. Immediately after I noticed some stiffness in my lower back and tension in my neck. I visited my primary care physician the following morning who noted mild muscle strain consistent with whiplash. I have been prescribed a short course of anti-inflammatories. Pain is currently 4 out of 10 and I have not missed work.
